title: Romualdez coaccused in plunder case surrenders
summary: A coaccused in the P7.44-billion plunder case of former Speaker Martin Romualdez has surrendered to the National Bureau of Investigation, the Office of the Ombudsman said in a statement on Friday.…

blocks.text: A coaccused in the P7.44-billion plunder case of former Speaker Martin Romualdez has surrendered to the National Bureau of Investigation, the Office of the Ombudsman said in a statement on Friday. According to the Ombudsman, coaccused Felicito Guevarra surrendered to the NBI on Thursday after prosecutors moved for his passport’s cancellation. READ: Romualdez co-accused surrenders
